commit.message:
Try to fix Github actions trigger on labels

It looks like "label created" happens when someone creates a
new label for the project as a whole. And we want to trigger on
"pull request labeled" for when some adds a label to a PR.

Use file-changes action

since otherwise labels will be ignored if the right files aren't
changed.

milestone.description:
Main features:
- Pattern matching
- Generics / subscripted container types
- `@cython.collection_type()`
- `restrict`
- more vectorcalls
- more thread safety
- smaller modules, more shared code
- remove Py3.8 support, keep Py3.9+
